review_summary.college_name: TNPESU Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Selvam Educational Institutions are good.

content.Placements: The highest salary package offered in our course 5 LPA. Teachers are highly experienced and knowledgeable. There is good training for placements. Semester exams are not difficult. Our college has various departments with more opportunities for placements in various companies.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is allowed only for laptops. Classrooms are very good, and the hostel food is also good. But they have high rates. Hostel room and facilities are excellent. I am lucky to study at this college. We have very high-cost laboratory materials in the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Our college has good placements. Teachers are knowledgeable, and the infrastructure is very good.

content.Placements: Civil engineering is the best branch for placements. About 80% of the students got internships. Some good companies visit our college and hire students. About 30% of the students got placements, and some students got placed in local companies. The highest salary package offered is 10 LPA, while the lowest salary package offered is 4 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: All facilities are good, and there are a Wi-Fi facility and library. Google classrooms are good, and sports and canteen are good in our college. Medical facilities are good and always available, and the sports coach is good, who provides daily motivation and guidelines.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: The college for learn to easy and get to freedom.

content.Placements: Only the low scale companies come to the college. Last year, the placement rate was 87%. The placement training classes are available, it is the most amazing training class. An excellent placement programme is provided. Last year, the medium salary package was offered to the students. The college provides good services.
content.Infrastructure: The college structure, hostel, food, and sports are good. The college is promoting sports to the national and international standards. In sports quota, the college provides a free seat, free accommodation and free food. The google classrooms are amazing. The hostel rooms are big and have good water service.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: The truth about my college, and I love it.

content.Placements: During our final year, we had some placements in various fields, i.e. both professional and BPO. In my set, we had a placement of 87% but less than 5% of the people went to the job got via placement. The minimum salary is Rs. 1,00,000/annum and the maximum salary is Rs. 4,50,000/annum (off-campus). Allsec, Zealous, Span Technologies, Aqua Retails, Tech Mahindra are the companies that visit. Marketing, call centre, developers in start-ups are the roles offered. There is no internship. We have a placement cell. They are trying to do their best for our betterment.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: Good place to educate yourself.

content.Placements: To be frank the placing student capacity of my batch was a bit more when compared to our seniors. Placement percentage had been increased from 73.3% to 86.3%. The highest salary offered was 4.5 L by IVTL Infoview and lowest salary was 1.44 L. For ECE, core companies like Zebronics, TATA Communications and many came with affordable packages, student were offered roles of junior engineers, trainee engineers etc. Many startup IT companies like JusPay, Vernalis etc recruited CSE & IT department students with good packages. MNCs like Tech Mahindra, HCL also had conducted their drives.

faqs.answer: No, After completing LLB you become a lawyer, however, you are still not an advocate and hence cannot practice law. To become an advocate and to practice law as a profession, you mandatorily need to clear the All India Bar Examination (AIBE). After qualifying AIBE, one can practice law as a full fledged profession.

faqs.question: Can I become a lawyer without a Law degree?
faqs.answer: No, you cannot become a lawyer without a Law degree. You mandatorily need to obtain degrees such as BA/BCom/BSc/BBA LLB or LLB in order to be a lawyer in India. To become a lawyer, one must first complete three-year or five-year LLB from a recognised university and possess degree certificate. Then, they must enrol themselves in local Bar Council of the concerned state and enrolled as an advocate. Within two years of the enrolment, they must appear and clear AIBE in order to be eligible to practise anywhere in India.

admission_process.title: UPES Dehradun Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: UPES Dehradunis a private University offering more than eighty courses in the fields of Engineering, Computer Science, Law, Design, Business, Health Sciences, Modern Media, and Liberal Studies, through its constituent schools. Admission to UPES Dehradun is entrance-based. The University also conducts other rounds of selection such as Group discussions and Personal Interviews before granting admission to certain courses.
UPES Dehradunhas been ranked the number 1 private University in Academic Reputation in India as per the QS World University Rankings, 2025.
The key highlights of UPES Dehradun Admission 2025 are mentioned in the below table:

UPES Dehradun courses admission is entrance-based. Interested candidates need to appear for relevant entrance test to become eligible for admission at UPES Dehradun. The table mentioned below showcases the UPES Dehradun admission criteria for various courses:

UPES Dehradun Admission 2025 process has been started. The admission process is executed in a structured manner, accommodating both merit and entrance-based admissions. Interested candidates must carefully check the eligibility criteria before proceeding with the UPES Dehradun application process. The step-wise UPES Admission Process 2025 is mentioned:
Step 1: UPES Dehradun Application Process

Candidates interested in UPES Dehradun admission must start by completing the online registration process. UPES Dehradun applications are available on its official website, https://www.upes.ac.in/. Candidates should ensure they pay the required application fee, which isINR 1,350for all courses, within the specified deadline to complete the complete the application process.
Step 2: UPES Dehradun Selection & Shortlisting

After submission of applications, candidates undergo a screening process. The screening involves assessing eligibility and selection criteria. Applicants are shortlisted based on their academic records and other relevant qualifications, as specified in the eligibility criteria. For specific courses, UPES Dehradun conducts its own entrance exams likeUPESPAT, UPESMET UG, UPESPAT, UPESEAT,among others, as well as accepts national-level entrance exams likeMAT, XAT, CAT, NMAT, SAT India, CUET, etc.,for admission. The final selection stage involves a personal interview to assess the candidate's suitability, aspirations, and alignment with the chosen programme
Step 3: UPES Dehradun Admission Confirmation
After completion of all the selection rounds, the institution will notify the selected candidates of their admission status, through email or other appropriate means.

To secure their admission, selected candidates must complete the required admission formalities and submit the necessary documents within the specified deadline, confirming their seat in the programme.

faqs.question: Can I get into UPES without entrance exam?
faqs.answer: Yes, UPESEAT is University of Petroleum & Energy Studies Engineering Aptitude Test. University of Petroleum & Energy Studies  (UPES) conducts the examination every year online for the admission of suitable candidates to its various BTech courses. It is a self-financed, UGC and AICTE approved University. Admission in UPES is done through UPESEAT, JEE Main scorecard, and Board merit list. 80% of seats of the University are filled through UPESEAT and the rest 20% are filled on the basis of the JEE Main scorecard and Class 12 result. Check below the sections of UPESEAT:SectionsNo. of QuestionsMathematics / Biology35Physics35Chemistry35Comprehension20Total No. of Questions125

faqs.question: Is it difficult to get admission in School of Health Sciences and Technology Courses, UPES - Experience Centre?
faqs.answer: UPES Dehradun offers admission to most of the courses based on entrance exam scores. Candidates have to appear for the university or national-level entrance exam for admission. UPSEAT conducted by the university is competitive due to limited seats and large number of applications. Aspirants who prepare well can pass the entrance test.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in School of Health Sciences and Technology, UPES?
faqs.answer: To get admission in School of Health Sciences and Technology, UPES candidates might have to complete multi-step process. Check below the admission steps for UPES:Application:The mode of application is online. The application fee for BTech, BPharma, MSc, and BSc is  INR 1,350 each.Selection rounds:The university conducts its own entrance exams for providing admission to specific courses. Apart from these, UPES Dehradun also accepts national-level entrance exams like CUET UG, NEET, JEE Main, etc.Admission confirmation:After completion of the selection rounds, the shortlisted candidates are called for verification of the documents. Aspirants need to pay course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

faqs.question: Can I become a lawyer after completing my LLB?
faqs.answer: No, After completing LLB you become a lawyer, however, you are still not an advocate and hence cannot practice law.To become an advocate and to practice law as a profession, you mandatorily need to clear theAll India Bar Examination (AIBE). After qualifying AIBE, one can practice law as a full fledged profession.

hostel.description: University of Petroleum and Energy Studies has separate hostel for boys and girls with a capacity of more than 2000 students at Bidholi and Kandoli campuses. All the hostels have wi fi facility for learning.Common room has been provided in each hostel for relaxation and 24*7 power back up and solar power water heaters facility is available.The hostels have mess facility.Air conditioned hostels are also available. UPES has also tied up with private hostels for girls students in the city to offer appropriate accommodation outside the campus. All accommodation is on a triple sharing basis.

library.description: UPES’s library has a seating capacity of more than 400 students and contains over 73,327 volumes of publications including books, standards, reports, proceedings and more than 150 National and International journals in the fields of petroleum exploration, power, infrastructure, chemical, computer, electrical, electronic and mechanical engineering, information technology and management, etc. It also has a rich collection of online resources in terms of CDs, access to specialized portals on oil and gas and power related information. UPES has also acquired institutional memberships of the British Council Library, the American Centre Library, the AIMA Library, the Central Secretariat library and DELNET, IIP, WIHG Dehradun. As a part of collaboration IFP,France has gifted a large no. of books and Shell, a global oil major has also gifted a large number of technical books to the library.

content.Placements: About the placement our college Shri Krishna University placement cell is doing very well to place students in the IT sector banking sector nursing sector doctors' line and the placement cell staff is very good and exploring how to do interviews and learn how to select the process of placement.

content.Placements: This college provides good campus placements and it adds good and valuable skills to students. Around 20-30% of students got placed after this course. Some non-profitable companies are seeking graduates for the services. The best role in this course I think is a yoga teacher.

review_summary.college_name: Kushabhau Thakre Patrakarita Avam Jansanchar Vishwavidyalaya Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with faculty and infrastructure, but placements could improve.

content.Placements: The quality of my college placement support is decent but not stellar, around 30-50 percent of civil students land on-campus offers. Companies like TCS, Wipro, ServiceNow and Accenture visit for recruitment. Average packages range between 3 LPA to 9 LPA with top performers landing up 8 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: My college campus feels modern and clean with spacious classrooms, smart labs and well-maintained civil engineering facilities. In my civil department, there's a dedicated lab for surveying, concrete, hydraulics, and practical tools are available. The library is equipped with digital resources and physical books, and the overall vibe is green and pleasant.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: College reality: Likes and dislikes.

content.Placements: 65-75% of students were placed in our courses. The highest package taken by a student is 400,000 per annum; the average package is 200,000, and the lowest package is 100,000. About 50% of students got internships from our courses because of their studying ability and personality.
content.Infrastructure: The quality of food available in the canteen is very good and very tasty, and the facilities for medicine are also good. We have a big activity hall for games and functions, like the annual function and Navratri Garba. The facilities in the classrooms are also good, and we have good air conditioning.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in Journalism and Mass Communication - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the college is very average in terms of studies, campus, students, and events.

content.Placements: Around 40% of students are placed; companies like ETv and local news channels hire from KTU; internships depend on students and not the college; the roles offered are content writers, anchors, and others from the news industry only. The average package is only INR 1-2 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is a mess; there is nothing to do in it. Only a few people lived there. It's affordable but not at all good. Beds and electricity are good; food and everything else need to be charged separately and as an optional part of the hostel fee. The girls hostel closes at 8 p.m., and for boys, it is 10 p.m.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: The college is nice join.

content.Placements: The placement cell is not very good, but you will have some opportunities to improve your C. V. through extracurricular activities provided by the college. It also has an NCC or NSS cell, which prepares you for jobs in the police or army, as well as other facilities.

individual_reviews.title: Review of Gardi Vidyapith Group of Institutions.

admission_process.title: Ellenki College of Engineering and Technology Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: Ellenki College of Engineering and Technology admissionis mainly entrance-based. Also known asECET, the college offers BTech, MTech, MBA, and Diploma courses. The institute conducts an online mode of application for all the courses. ECET offers admission to courses based on entrance exam score. The college accepts entrance exams such as TS EAMCET, TSICET, etc. for admission to specific courses.

The institute offers several specialisations in BTech, MTech, and diploma courses. Admission to ECET is entrance-based. The institute accepts TS EAMCET, TSICET, TS POLYCET, GATE, and TS PGECET for admission to BTech, MBA, diploma, and MTech courses respectively. Check belowECET coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:

Ellenki College of Engineering and Technology admission process is entrance-based. Candidates who get shortlisted based on their merit are eligible for admission. Below are the steps to get a seat in the college:
Step 1: Visit the ECET Website
Candidates seeking admission to various programme at the Ellenki College of Engineering and Technology must fill up the admission form online.
Step 2: ECET Selection Round

The college shortlists candidates based on entrance exam score. Aspirants must qualify TS EAMCET and TSICET for admission to BTech and MBA courses, respectively. The selection for MTech programme is based on GATE or TS PGECET scores.
Step 3: Final Seat Confirmation & Admission Confirmation

Ellenki College of Engineering and Technology will release a merit list of the selected candidates for the final seat allotment. Candidates selected for the course must complete their enrollment by submitting theEllenki College of Engineering and Technology feeswithin the given deadline to grab the seats.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for average students.
reviews.review_text: Our college had best infrastructure and facilities for every department, including Wi-Fi, classrooms, and libraries. The hostel facilities and the quality of food in the mess and canteen were very good. The college provided 24/7 facilities. The campus also had sports grounds.

reviews.review_heading: Average college with good infrastructure.

The classrooms were good, and the library was big and had all kinds of books. The hostel facilities were good, and the food in the mess and canteen was hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: This course has good future in future.
reviews.review_text: Our college is best in terms of infrastructure, like cricket grounds, Wi-Fi, good classrooms, and a well-stocked library with all types of books. The quality of facilities in our college is very good, and the food available in the mess and canteen is very good and neat. Our college has 24/7 medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Ellenki College of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: In this college, infrastructure quality was very good and nice. The college departments provided facilities like fast Wi-Fi, labs, libraries, classrooms, bathrooms, etc. The canteen food was very good. They provided neat and clean meals. There was a sports committee that organized sports and game facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It was a good college with good placements and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Our college excelled in infrastructure. It had a good Wi-Fi and neat classrooms. There were well-equipped labs for every department. Our college had a big library with collection of books. The quality of food in the mess and hostel was very good.

reviews.review_heading: Not a good college for studying.
reviews.review_text: College provides facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, library, table tennis, turf, etc. The quality of medical services provided by our college is the best. However, the food is not good and is average in quality. Cricket is my favorite sport provided at the college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Ellenki College of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: Our college had very good infrastructure with all necessary facilities. Each department had its own labs. Campus hostel, located near the campus was highly secure and offered good food facilities, a mess, canteen, and ground. Medical facilities were always available in our college.

reviews.review_heading: A good college with a good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Our college is the best in the tier 3 colleges category. The facilities and infrastructure are excellent, and there is a Wi-Fi facility. We have good classrooms, a big library with all types of books, and labs for every department. The college also provides medical facilities. The quality of food in the mess and canteen, as well as the hostel, is excellent. The college also has sports grounds for all types of games.

reviews.review_heading: The best college with no enjoyment.
reviews.review_text: Our college is the best in terms of infrastructure and facilities. The college has facilities like Wi-Fi, labs for every department, a big library with all types of books, and good classrooms. The quality of food in the hostel and mess is good, and the college also provides 24/7 medical facilities. The college has sports grounds for all games.

reviews.review_heading: I'm completely satisfied with the placements provided in our course in 2021.
reviews.review_text: In our department, the facilities are amazing. They provide many facilities, like AC classrooms, libraries, Wi-Fi routers, auditoriums, seminar halls, and project labs. The hostel is good with the facilities like a variety of food items in the kitchen and canteen. The rooms are neat and clean.

reviews.review_heading: Really good placements are offered in our year from our course.
reviews.review_text: Our entire campus is widely spread along 45 acres of land with many great facilities, like separate blocks for different branches of students, AC classrooms, library, free Wi-Fi around the entire campus, placement rooms, auditorium, project labs, lawn, waiting room, indoor complex, etc. The hostel is also excellent in providing quality facilities like good food, clean rooms, and a hygienic environment. The medical team is doing an excellent job and they're available for students the entire day. ...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Ellenki College of Engineering and Technology for diploma admission.
reviews.review_text: This college's infrastructure department and hostel facilities provided the same and very high quality of products, like classrooms, bathrooms, bedrooms, labs, libraries, etc. In this college, there were multiple sports committees. Event committee was organised every year. Game tournament and cultural committee organised dance, fashion shows, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure with decent placements.
reviews.review_text: Our college is the best in terms of infrastructure, with good classrooms, WiFi facilities, labs for every department and a big library with all types of books. The quality of food in the hostel and canteen is good. The facilities in our hostel and college are excellent. The college also provides 24/7 medical facilities and there are sports grounds for every game. Our college ground is very big and large.

reviews.review_heading: Ellenki College of Engineering: Affordable learning, growing opportunities, and campus Life.
reviews.review_text: Particularly in the Computer Science and Engineering department, there are multiple specialized laboratories. Each lab is well-equipped with a range of computing systems and software to cater to various aspects of computer science education and project needs.

reviews.review_heading: College is not good at faculty. Only some teachers, not all, that's it.
reviews.review_text: About the facilities and infrastructure, the infrastructure is good, and there is Wi-Fi, but it is only for faculty, not for students. Facilities are not good in hostels. The campus is not correct, especially in the girls' hostel. The boys are serving food at night, which is not good. In the laboratory and library, the books we need are not available.

content.Placements: BCET CSE offers 75-85% placements. Packages range from 3-6 LPA on average, with the highest 12-24 LPA. Top recruiters include TCS, Cognizant, Wipro, TechM, and Capgemini. Around 60-75% get internships in IT firms/startups. Roles offered: SDE, developer, analyst, QA, support.

Medical help is available 24/7. Sports facilities include ground, indoor games, and events, making campus life manageable and active.

reviews.review_heading: This is a review for Bengal College of Engineering and Technology College.
reviews.review_text: The quality of the hostel, faculty members, and classes is also nice and good. The college infrastructure is neat and tidy.

reviews.review_heading: Decent placements, good campus life, and a strong CSE environment.
reviews.review_text: BCET CSE has good Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, updated labs, and a well-stocked library. Hostels are decent, food is average, and the canteen is better. Medical help is available 24/7. Sports facilities include ground, indoor games, and events, making campus life manageable and active.

reviews.review_heading: The honest answers campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities are good at my college. The full campus is covered by Wi-Fi, and we have fully air-conditioned facilities. We have computer labs, separate labs for other subjects like Physics, Chemistry, digital & analog, etc. Hostels for boys and girls have a cafeteria on our campus and a grocery shop for essential needs. We have a basketball court as well as ground for different sports like football, volleyball, and cricket. We have SKS Medical College and Vivekananda Hospita...

reviews.review_heading: Real face of BCET Durgapur.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi. We never saw labs. We have green board classrooms with least amount of space and benches. Library is only for issuing books only. Quality of food is like getting atleast 1 insect in every 10 students. Medical room is there but there is never a doctor or nurse as it is a store room. Playground is full of huge grass like about 4 feet, but some way of playing sports or online game is there.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement scope for students if they have skills. Faculty members could have been better.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good only as per the rating of the college. They have a particular lab for almost all departments where 75%-80% of the equipment is working. Hostel is average as expected not so Hi-Fi but decent. The cleaning staff is there but not consistent and hostel mess food I would rate 2.5/5.

reviews.review_heading: A good place away from home to learn, build connections, and explore career opportunities.
reviews.review_text: There was a separate girl's hostel with proper security, Wi-Fi, laundry, food, and medical facilities. All the facilities were good. Mess was always accessible. The food was healthy and medical had 24X7 emergency facility as well. Sports and games were all open until 8:00 PM on the campus with security.

reviews.review_heading: The faculty of the college is the best.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities of the college are very good, and the infrastructure available for the course/department, like Wi-Fi, class, sports, medical facilities, and library, are very good. Also, the hostel facilities are the best, and food quality is too good.

reviews.review_heading: Feedback and review of my college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good, and the course is very helpful. The quality of facilities in the hostel is also good. The mess facilities are also good. Medical facilities are also good. Sports and games are available. Wi-Fi, labs, and campus-wide Wi-Fi are also available.

reviews.review_heading: If your skills are good, you can easily get jobs in the IT sector.
reviews.review_text: Bengal College of Engineering and Technology is very good. The labs are very good, and our faculty members are very experienced and helpful. BCET classrooms are good, and our college library is a very peaceful place. Our playground is the best.

reviews.review_heading: BCET as the finest college in Durgapur.
reviews.review_text: I only have a complaint about the seminar hall. It needs a vast upgrade; the projectors are old, and the sound systems are old. But the other infrastructures are okay; they are all well and nicely organized. I haven't opted for the hostel, so I can't explain that.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure but worst faculties. Placement and internship opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The only thing that my college has is its infrastructure. Our college has one of the biggest campuses in our city, Durgapur. The labs are very good. We have Windows 11 on almost every computer in our lab. Our college has a pretty big library, but nowadays, the Wi-Fi system is the worst. There is a pretty big playground at our college. Also, the hostels are very good, but the hostel food is a little bit oily. Nowadays, we have smart classrooms in our college. Because of a Durga temple, our hostel...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Bengal College of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility is good. Veg and non-veg both are provided by the hostel. Most of the students are from Bihar rather than Bengal and some of the students are from Jharkhand. The hostel campus is a good and peaceful place. The warden is helping by nature and supportive.

reviews.review_heading: Experience of my college life.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and services infrastructure available in my college are quite good. There is a separate section of books and reading in the library. Wi-Fi facilities are available for the students. Training and placement guides us for the future and company placements.

reviews.review_heading: Bcet Review by Bijoy Adhikary
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is impressive. All blocks are separate from each other: CST, Core, CE, and me. So it looks neat and clean. Also, the college library is located on the college campus, and there are so many engineering books and competitive exam books. And in the college lab, the computers are good, but some labs’ computers are very old, so this is a negative point. But all labs have AC, but the college campus does not have Wi-Fi for students.

reviews.review_heading: College with lower fees. Completely worth it.
reviews.review_text: The campus is equipped with Wi-Fi and internet connections and also hostel has an internet connection for the pre-final year and final year students. There is a central library other than the departmental library. The hostel has a twin seater room with individual cupboards a study table and chairs for both occupants and also the mess food is okay.

review_summary.college_name: Madras School of Economics Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: PGDM in Research and Business Analytics - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: The placement and faculty members are very good.

content.Placements: The college gives an organized placement to students. All types of companies visit in college from many different backgrounds. The college gives full preparation for the placement drive and interview. The highest salary is 25 LPA, and the average salary is 11 LPA. Companies like HDFC Bank, Yes Bank, etc., frequently visit. Those companies hire most of the students.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel rooms are properly furnished and well-maintained. Students share rooms with each other. If students score good, then they have a chance to get a single room. The quality of the mess food is hygienic and tasty. The first year hostel fee is Rs. 1,500, and after 3 years it increases to Rs. 55,000 per semester.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Financial Economics - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Overall, it was the best college for the M.A. in Financial Economics course.

content.Placements: About 83% of students from our course got placement. The highest salary in our study was 22 LPA, the average package was 15 LPA, and the minimum package was 4 LPA. Top recruiting firms, including JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, Bank of America, and more, visited our campus for placements. About 70% of students from our course received internship opportunities. Roles such as Economists and Market Research Analysts were offered to the students.
content.Infrastructure: We had everything like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and departmental libraries. Facilities in our hostels, as well as the food in the mess and restaurants, hospital, sports, and games, were excellent. Facilities were provided not only to Tamil Nadu students but also to students from other states and countries.

individual_reviews.course: PGDM in Finance - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Most of the faculty members are reachable.

content.Placements: As it is the first batch (PGDM), the placement process has been as expected not too great but not that bad as well. Internship opportunities are huge for PGDM students. If you don't get in through the internship process, the faculty members will help you get into some companies through their contacts in the market. Stipends offered range from Rs. 10,000 pm to 1 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: There's only 1 boys hostel and 3 girls hostel as the population of girls is higher on this campus. The hostel provides very minimalistic facilities. You'll have to share common bathroom/washrooms. There are no AC and no washing machines but you can get your clothes cleaned by the "Akkas" who clean our rooms.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Financial Economics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Placements are good it but can be better.

content.Placements: Around 80% of students got placed. The highest package being 21 LPA and the lowest is 9 LPA. The average package is around 14.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are - Barclays, Bank of America, Standard Chartered, Accenture AI, Wells Fargo, and Citi Analytics. Around 25% of students got placed in Citi Analytics and Wells Fargo.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is quite good with neat and clean hostel and a good peer community culture. Library is good and Wi-Fi is okay. Mess is okay with both North Indian and South Indian food. Sports tournaments is conducted once every year which includes football and cricket.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Applied Quantitative Finance - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: My best college - An honest review.

content.Placements: Country's top establishments and organizations seek our placement cell to hire us. Almost 95% of the students got placed in these companies. The average salary package offered ranges from 7 LPA - 15 LPA. The rest opted for research opportunities. Most of the students were recruited by leading organizations like HSBC, Nathan Associate, IFMR, Citigroup, Symphony, and Genpact. Final placements in 2019, 114 students were placed. The highest salary package offered was 16.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Our course had a duration of 2 years and boundless scope was constituted in our curriculum to explore the area of research in the disciplines we wish to flourish upon. Such research opportunities were the best part of our curriculum. Our hostel was the best place and mess was the worst in the college. There was no warden, we could go out at any time but I had heard that things had changed now. College management was little strict. Food was the biggest issue but now the caterer had changed so that was not a problem anymore.

hostel_campus.college_name: Madras School of Economics Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: The placement and faculty members are very good.
reviews.review_text: The hostel rooms are properly furnished and well-maintained. Students share rooms with each other. If students score good, then they have a chance to get a single room. The quality of the mess food is hygienic and tasty. The first year hostel fee is Rs. 1,500, and after 3 years it increases to Rs. 55,000 per semester.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it was the best college for the M.A. in Financial Economics course.
reviews.review_text: We had everything like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and departmental libraries. Facilities in our hostels, as well as the food in the mess and restaurants, hospital, sports, and games, were excellent. Facilities were provided not only to Tamil Nadu students but also to students from other states and countries.

reviews.review_heading: Most of the faculty members are reachable.
reviews.review_text: There's only 1 boys hostel and 3 girls hostel as the population of girls is higher on this campus. The hostel provides very minimalistic facilities. You'll have to share common bathroom/washrooms. There are no AC and no washing machines but you can get your clothes cleaned by the "Akkas" who clean our rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are good it but can be better.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is quite good with neat and clean hostel and a good peer community culture. Library is good and Wi-Fi is okay. Mess is okay with both North Indian and South Indian food. Sports tournaments is conducted once every year which includes football and cricket.

reviews.review_heading: My best college - An honest review.
reviews.review_text: Our course had a duration of 2 years and boundless scope was constituted in our curriculum to explore the area of research in the disciplines we wish to flourish upon. Such research opportunities were the best part of our curriculum. Our hostel was the best place and mess was the worst in the college. There was no warden, we could go out at any time but I had heard that things had changed now. College management was little strict. Food was the biggest issue but now the caterer had changed so tha...

reviews.review_heading: Madras School of Economics- a newcomer for Bachelor's.
reviews.review_text:
Rudimentary facilities: WiFi is available but nothing amazing.
Usually triple sharing rooms are given out but you might get a twin sharing room as well; triple sharing rooms are bigger in size compared to the twin sharing rooms.
The mess food is basic but hygienic—a good mix of North-South palette.

reviews.review_heading: Great college and nice placements last year.
reviews.review_text: The college has good facilities to girls, like hostels that are under cctv surveillance and the good security at the campus gate and outside is not allowed. The good classrooms and labs. library is well stocked. The infrastructure of the college is nice, with good buildings and sufficient classrooms and good washrooms, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Our campus life is great.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms were very good. Our campus was well-maintained. The hostel fee structure was affordable. Our campus was Wi-Fi enabled. The food quality was average.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has highly educated faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The hostel rooms are good, well-maintained, and well-furnished. We have to share rooms. Students will get a single room if they score good marks in exams. The mess provides good food. The hostel fee for the first 3 years is Rs. 1,500. After 3 years, it will be Rs. 55,000 per semester.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with placement but dissatisfied with the faculty, except a few very good ones.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite good. We have properly functioning labs and classrooms, all completely air conditioned. However, the hostel is quite sub standard. There are no ACs and 3 sharing rooms with a common bathroom on a single floor. The food of the mess is pretty average. They do provide a good variety of all cuisines.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are good with good courses, but the faculty members are average.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. The library has AC facility which is really helpful during the summer season. Classrooms are really good, and the quality of food provided on campus is average. Sports and games facilities are available for students, and all festivals are celebrated with great enthusiasm.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the faculty, the infrastructure is good, and the placements are awesome.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. The college provides all the facilities. But, the only problem a student faces is the poor quality food. Specifically, the students from North India will not like the food. There is a playground for cricket and football, and also a volleyball ground is available.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best college for Masters in economics.
reviews.review_text:
Less number of students with decent infrastructure, batch size each year goes to a limit of max 180, comfortable hostel life, a very decent mess food, AC library, chilled campus life, decent classroom 
1. The campus is located at the heart of the city with everything available within the range of campus. 
2. Safe for girls because of strict rules for both boys and girls 
3. Canteen is life there 
U can't expect more from a post-graduate college offering you placement before you end your Masters....

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, dissatisfied with faculty and a decent infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: All sort of facilities available in the college. The college has good Wi-Fi signals across all the rooms, and the classrooms are pretty spacious. There is also a medical facility in the college for an emergency. There is a small playground, but manageable and the quality of food is not up to the mark on the campus. We are also provided with the canteen in the college itself. The infrastructure of the college is not that good.

reviews.review_heading: Totally satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text:
College campus has a good building, big library and lab. Also, there are smart classes available in each class with projector and PCs in each class. 
Classes are of enough size and well ventilated. Wi-Fi is also there. 
Also, the college provides its own email ID and communicates through them. 
The canteen is of a smaller size but you can avail good quality pasta and juices. Hostel rooms are well ventilated as well and all the students are well attached to each other. There is a backup generator...

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Program in Data Science with GEN AI and ML - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Amazing and the best faculty.

content.Placements: The college is one of the pioneering institutions in the field of Data Science in India. The highest package offered to the previous batch was 16 LPA and the average of 12 LPA. Companies such as Wells Fargo and EY came to the campus with offers on day zero.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is okay. The campus is situated at the heart of the bustling city of Bangalore and is located in HSR layout near sector one area. There is Wi-Fi everywhere on the campus and library facilities are provided on the basis of ID cards that are provided.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Program in Data Science with GEN AI and ML - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Our college provides amazing faculty members and good placements.

content.Placements: Our college provides one of the best placement assistance to data science students. Placement provided for the previous batch was good. Many students got the highest salary package of 16 LPA and the average salary package is 12 LPA. Many top companies like Wells Fargo, Welspun Group, etc., visit to hire students.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our campus is situated at the heart of HSR and it is among the good area in Bangalore. All the classrooms are Wi-Fi enabled. Library cards are provided for the students to access the library.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Program in Data Science with GEN AI and ML - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: A great place to learn!

content.Placements: College holds a good name in terms of placement. It maintains a record of placing at least 90% students from previous batches in companies with an average pay of 7 LPA. As students of current batch (July2022) we are instructed to prepare for the upcoming placement drive in November which is just 3-4 months after our commencement of the course.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure isn't a thing to recommend. The classroom has no podium which is the main drawback and regarding Wi-Fi it is not much stable and we are facing glitches sometimes. There is no campus hostel but there are lot of PGs in and around the area where the college is located.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Program in Data Science with GEN AI and ML - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the faculty and good placements in 2021.

content.Placements: Placements start after the end of the first trimester. The average salary package offered is about 10 LPA. Almost everyone got placed. About 95% of people got placed in the previous batch. Top roles offered are data analyst and business analyst.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is well maintained. I have faced no issues with the Wi-Fi. The institute has a library from which you can borrow books. The institute is open till 6 PM, so you can study there even if your class gets over. Classrooms are well kept and cleaning is done regularly.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Program in Data Science with GEN AI and ML - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Review of Praxis Business School, Bangalore.

content.Placements: Currently, our batch hasn't started with the placement process as it is a new one. Students in our senior batch have been placed with an average salary package of about 10 LPA. Most students generally get placed if they prepare well.
content.Infrastructure: Our campus doesn't have a hostel, mess, or canteen. Students have to make accommodations for themselves. PGs are available nearby. Wi-Fi, classrooms, and the library are good. Classrooms are clean.
content.Faculty: Teaching quality depends on you, the course, and faculty members. As a 9-month course, it can be a little fast-paced for some subjects, but ideal for others. If you do your share of work, you can get the results. Semester exams here are a bit different than what we are used to in schools and colleges. We are tested on our ability to apply knowledge taught by the faculty to solve problems.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing and the best faculty.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is okay. The campus is situated at the heart of the bustling city of Bangalore and is located in HSR layout near sector one area. There is Wi-Fi everywhere on the campus and library facilities are provided on the basis of ID cards that are provided.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides amazing faculty members and good placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our campus is situated at the heart of HSR and it is among the good area in Bangalore. All the classrooms are Wi-Fi enabled. Library cards are provided for the students to access the library.

reviews.review_heading: A great place to learn!
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure isn't a thing to recommend. The classroom has no podium which is the main drawback and regarding Wi-Fi it is not much stable and we are facing glitches sometimes. There is no campus hostel but there are lot of PGs in and around the area where the college is located.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the faculty and good placements in 2021.
reviews.review_text: Everything is well maintained. I have faced no issues with the Wi-Fi. The institute has a library from which you can borrow books. The institute is open till 6 PM, so you can study there even if your class gets over. Classrooms are well kept and cleaning is done regularly.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Praxis Business School, Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: Our campus doesn't have a hostel, mess, or canteen. Students have to make accommodations for themselves. PGs are available nearby. Wi-Fi, classrooms, and the library are good. Classrooms are clean.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement records, decent facilities & industry relevant curriculum.
reviews.review_text: The institute offers decent facilities in the campus. There are 3 floors consisting of classrooms, library & meeting rooms. There is constant Wi-Fi network on all floors. The classrooms are fully air conditioned & are equipped with projectors as well as white boards. The institute does not provide hostel facility.

reviews.review_heading: Teaching of concepts are excellent, practical oriented, good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: All are good and well maintained. They provide Wi-Fi, library, classrooms are air conditioned, there is no hostel facilities provided by the institute but there multiple option around the institute. The security of the institute is also extraordinary.

reviews.review_heading: College summary - infrastructure, campus, placements etc.
reviews.review_text: The college campus has all the required infrastructure that makes the study easier. The classrooms are air conditioned and ventilated. However, the Bangalore campus has little to offer in terms of the campus. It is a stand alone building and the living conditions are a bit costly.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with our college regarding placements and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Our college has all facilities like big classrooms, a Wi-Fi facility, and a library. The hostel is not available at the Bangalore branch but the Kolkata branch has it. Many PGs for boys and girls are available near the college in Bangalore.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Praxis Business School.
reviews.review_text: The hostel and canteen are not available in our college. Students have to look for and arrange their accommodation. Students should go nearby for three times food. There are lots of PGs within walking distance. It has a campus in Kolkata. The Kolkata campus has a hostel facility.

reviews.review_heading: The course is good. Prepare before joining the course.
reviews.review_text: We do not have campus in Bangalore branch as it is there in calcutta campus. Here we have 2 floors where we have two classroom one for juniors and one for seniors and we have pgp office were you can clarify your doughts and we have Wi-Fi available and library is also there.

reviews.review_heading: Great place to start your data science career.
reviews.review_text: There is no campus setup for the Bangalore branch. The 3 floors of a Building have been used for classrooms, offices and placement rooms. The facilities like Wi-Fi, Projector, Library, Air conditioned classroom. There is no hostel facilities and food arrangements in the Bangalore branch.

reviews.review_heading: Great place to start your Data Science journey as a student.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like Wi-Fi, library, air conditioned classrooms are there. There is no hostel facility in Bangalore branch so students have to stay in nearby PGs but the Kolkata branch has hostel facility. Many PGs are available near the college in Bangalore.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with good infrastructure and great lecturers.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, classrooms, library and other facilities were good. Presentation modules were very helpful. There was no hostel on the Bangalore campus but I heard that the hostel on the Kolkata campus was good. Classrooms are always open for us to study and help us to learn more.

reviews.review_heading: Praxis is a great place to start your data-Science journey as a student.
reviews.review_text:
The infrastructure at the Bangalore campus isn't top-notch according to my perception. There seem to be a lot of connectivity issues when it comes to wi-fi which might be due to heavy rain. Apart from this, the dais at which the academician is teaching isn't visible to everyone in the class. The acoustic design of the class also isn't that 
great. Classrooms are maintained great another hand except for lack of sanitary facilities.

review_summary.college_name: Sri Chaitanya Technical Campus Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Super placements and helpful faculty.

content.Placements: The placement process of this college is very good. Teachers guided us to get placement. Almost every one of us got a 3-month internship opportunity. It helped us to get placement. Around 85% of students got placed in various companies. The highest package offered was around 16 LPA and the lowest package offered was 3 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is one of the best. The whole campus is very clean. The classrooms are well maintained. There are dedicated labs and a library with a good collection. Wi-Fi facility is available. Our college is yet to provide hostel facilities. There are college buses for transport.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: College has well-experienced faculty members.

content.Placements: College is very good. We need to move to a walk-in interview. There are no college placements. College was established in 2011. Due to the pandemic, college has been changed, but college is good for studies compared to other colleges. We can get placement through a walk-in interview.
content.Infrastructure: There is no college hostel for boys. College hostel is provided only for girls. College was built in 2011. In girls hostel, they provide one room for 6 members. They provide water heaters and Wi-Fi. There are security cameras. As we go for food they provide breakfast, lunch, tea, and dinner.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with my college in the year 2023.

content.Placements: In my batch, most of my friends and I got placed in electrical industries. This all credit goes to my college and faculty. Most of the students got 70% and got placed in different streams like EEE, ECE, CSE, MECHANICAL, etc. Recruited companies like Radiant, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, Qualcomm, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel facility we have in our college provides quality food. And it provides fruits during summer days. We have a big playground in our college in which we used to play cricket, volleyball, etc. The food is good, and the medical facility also supports the students at no cost.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Value for money, one of the best colleges in karimnagar.

content.Placements: Our college has the maximum placement rate in the karimnagar. The maximum place of the students are in the software field in service based companies. The average placement package is between two to seven Lacs per year. The maximum package is around seven Lacs.
content.Infrastructure: Our college hostels full fill all the basic requirements of the student and the have been rated as above average when compared to all the private hostels that are available for the students in the karimnagar. The hostels of our college possess best food quality.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: I would not recommend joining this college.

content.Placements: Our college does not provide placement facilities. Students have to go off-campus. There is no special placement drive in our college. Our college is not tied up with the companies. Our college should focus on placements. Placements can be rated with 1 star out of 5.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides us with all facilities. Our college does not provide a hostel for boys. There is a library with limited books. Classrooms are spacious. There is no special bus stop for the college and we have to walk some distance from the road. There are labs with limited equipment but they are not working properly.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college for events and fests.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good facilities for students like a well-stocked library, computer labs, and fully equipped classrooms. Our college has a good canteen facility. The food served in the canteen is good and provides a variety of dishes. Our college has a basketball court and a volleyball court.

reviews.review_heading: I'm really satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi facility which is good, I think. The classrooms are okay-ish. The library is well maintained and disciplined. There is a canteen in the college which is good. And obviously, there is a medical facility. Sports and game facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for BBA, B.Com and MBA in Surat.
reviews.review_text: The college provides free Wi-Fi, library, and an auditorium. The classrooms are neat and clean and also have projectors to help students learn from presentations made by the teachers. The college also has a big cricket ground, football ground, and basketball court.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Metas Adventist college.
reviews.review_text: They don't have much infrastructure but have a canteen to spend time and enjoy. Library is available to study and read newspapers daily. There are separate boys and girls hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Metas Adventist College.
reviews.review_text: Every classroom has super-fast Wi-Fi, and we don't face any network issues during classes. The campus is really nice. A big canteen is available for students. Washrooms are available on every floor.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Metas Adventist College.
reviews.review_text: They don't have a huge infrastructure, they just have a canteen and a library where you really spend time on your studies. It is entirely up to you. Every semester, they organise sports events for you to remember, and you will have different games to play each semester.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Metas Adventist College.
reviews.review_text: The college has only one canteen where you can spend time but that is also not much attractive. They have a library and it is quite good and you can find books and read there quietly. Every semester, they organise a sports event where you can enjoy a lot.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Metas Adventist college.
reviews.review_text: They are having very good campus. One can get a lifelong moment in these places. They are organizing every semester different sports on their ground. So, you will be going to love it. They have a hall, auditorium, and so on.

reviews.review_heading: The college is not up to the mark.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good. According to me, the canteen food is not that good, and they should improve it. The classrooms are very good, but they do not have AC. Students feel very uncomfortable during the summer.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Metas Adventist College.
reviews.review_text: The campus only has a canteen, which is also very basic and too small. They charge so much money but don't provide any infrastructure, which is awful. College life is bad.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is only for degree and fun not for study.
reviews.review_text: They don't have anything other than a canteen that is very ordinary and simple. A small library is very annoying. They don't have the infrastructure but charge so much.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college and is affordable. Overall the crowd is also very good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. It wasn't new for me because it's like my school only. Their washrooms were the best and the college has CCTV cameras everywhere so it's safe too, and the overall college surroundings are also very good.

reviews.review_heading: Great Faculty, Makes you field ready, Average facilities
reviews.review_text:
Their was wifi in every class with good speed and the classrooms were also clean and no one was exasted in the class the Library also was very peaceful and was full of knowledge.
I don't know much about the hostel but the canteen food was average but the all other things were great

reviews.review_heading: I am not very satisfied; it is not value for money. But it gave me good placement.
reviews.review_text:
The infrastructure is very good. Our college has WiFi and a library but no AC, but that's ok because it has good ventilation.
The quality of the faculty and staff is above average. The food available is not at all good in the canteen. We have a huge playground where the college hosts regular sports activities.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good but infrastructure is poor.
reviews.review_text: Campus is not so impressive but there is a parking area. Students complain about sports as there are no sports facilities so I rate this college as 60 out of 100 based on infrastructure.
